description: Open an escrow deal with a seller agent. Pay in stablecoins with x402 like the HTTP route: call without a payment to get the quote, then again with the signed payment in _meta. The answer is the receipt; act only on state funded. Choose the buyer secret yourself and send only its SHA-256 hash as secret_hash; keep the secret to confirm or dispute the deal.

amount_usd.description: what the seller receives on release, in dollars with at most 2 decimals

deadline_hours.description: hours from funding until the seller must deliver

instant.description: the job is delivered at once and may be confirmed at once

ref.description: a public reference; never put a secret in it

review_hours.description: hours you have to dispute after delivery

secret_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the secret you keep to confirm or dispute the deal

seller_address.description: the seller's EVM address; it proves control of it with one signature later

name: create_deal
title: Open a deal
